```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

from src import binary_plots as pb

OUT_DIR = "./output/final_model"

pred = pd.read_csv(f"{OUT_DIR}/holdout_predictions.csv")
met = pd.read_csv(f"{OUT_DIR}/metrics.csv").iloc[0]

Y = met["y"]

# removable
if "y_bin" not in pred.columns:
    pred["y_bin"] = (pred[Y] > 0).astype(int)

assert "prob" in pred.columns, "holdout_predictions.csv must include `prob` (calibrated probability)."
assert ((pred["prob"] >= 0) & (pred["prob"] <= 1)).all(), "`prob` must be in [0,1]"

plot_dat = pred[["y_bin", "prob"]].copy()
plot_dat.rename(columns={"y_bin": "Y", "prob": "P"}, inplace=True)
```

Summary
```{python}
print("Model:", met["model"])
print("Outcome:", Y)
print("Holdout N:", int(met["holdout_n"]))
print("Holdout positive rate (y>0):", float(met["holdout_positive_rate"]))
print("Holdout WeightedAUC (matches tuning):", float(met["holdout_weighted_auc"]))
print("Holdout Top-1000 events captured:", float(met["holdout_top1000_weight"]))
print("Best params:", met["best_params"])
```

ROC curves

```{python}
# This will display the ROC plot and return the underlying ROC data
roc_df = pb.auc_plot(
    data=plot_dat,
    y_true="Y",
    y_scores=["P"],
    figsize=(6,6),
    save_plot=False
)
```

Cal plot
```{python}
cal_bins = pb.cal_data(
    prob="P",
    true="Y",
    data=plot_dat,
    bins=10,
    plot=True,
    figsize=(6,4),
    save_plot=False
)
```
